questions.text: Explain Cellular System Capacity expansion techniques: (a) Cell Splitting, (b) Cell Sectoring ($120^\circ$ and $60^\circ$ sectoring), and (c) Microcell Zone Concept. Explain Handoff Strategies (Hard handoff vs Soft handoff) and Trunking Efficiency (Erlang B vs Erlang C formulas).

Explain Free Space Path Loss (Friis Transmission Equation $P_r = P_t G_t G_r \left(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}\right)^2$). Explain Ground Reflection (2-Ray Model) and prove that received power falls off with the fourth power of distance: $P_r \approx P_t G_t G_r \frac{h_t^2 h_r^2}{d^4}$.

Explain Small-Scale Fading mechanisms (Multipath time delay spread, Doppler spread). Differentiate between: (a) Flat Fading vs Frequency Selective Fading (Coherence Bandwidth $B_c \approx \frac{1}{5\sigma_\tau}$), and (b) Fast Fading vs Slow Fading (Coherence Time $T_c \approx \frac{9}{16\pi f_m}$). Explain Rayleigh Fading and Rician Fading distributions.

Explain Digital Modulation schemes for mobile communications: Minimum Shift Keying (MSK), Gaussian MSK (GMSK) in GSM, and Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (16-QAM, 64-QAM). Why is constant-envelope modulation favored for power-efficient non-linear RF power amplifiers?

Explain Diversity Techniques to combat multipath fading: (a) Space / Antenna Diversity, (b) Frequency Diversity, and (c) Time Diversity. Compare Combining Techniques: Selection Combining (SC), Equal Gain Combining (EGC), and Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC).
